$comment: PROVISIONAL, NON-DURABLE INTERNAL/DOGFOOD NAMESPACE. The 'aoc/v0.1.0' value above is the internal monorepo-only schema-version slug used for the FEATURE-002 v0 build; it is NOT a published public schema URL. The published public $id value is operator-gated by G-NAME-BRAND + artifact-name + API-name resolution (CONCEPT-004 plan sections 5.1 and 6.1). The future rename from this internal slug to the public URL is orthogonal to contract_version and does not itself bump the contract version. Canonical contract serialization is YAML; lossless JSON is the equivalent mirror form. A single schema validates both forms via the parser's normalized object tree.
title: Agent Operating Contract (AOC) v0.1.0
description: The v0 Agent Operating Contract grammar. A contract document declares an app's purpose, context catalog, action catalog, human-ask path, receipt contract, anti-claims, and provenance so an agent operating on or alongside the app has a single legible source of truth. Per CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.5 non-goals, this schema is NOT an agent runtime, NOT a compliance certification, and NOT a permission system; it is a legibility commitment. The schema raw-requires exactly seven root keys (contract_version, app, contexts, actions, human_ask, receipts, provenance); anti_claims is optional-with-default in raw input and the default value below carries the canonical A0..A14 anti-claim list per CONCEPT-001 plan section 8.1. Per CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.8, unknown extension fields are accepted as no-op extensions unless the field name appears in the closed deferred-root-key list encoded as the not/anyOf rule on this schema (the readiness, cryptographic-attestation, and public-name-spec keys per FEATURE-002 plan section 2.3).

contract_version.description: Semver string targeting the AOC standard itself (e.g. 0.1.0). Pre-stable in v0.x per CONCEPT-001 plan section 3.1. The validator strict-and-bidirectionally matches this value against its target version per FEATURE-002 plan section 3.5.

id.description: Opaque, builder-chosen identifier for the app. No central registry, no collision check (CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.7). Synthetic examples in this catalog use the example. prefix.

purpose.description: Plain-prose statement (1-2 sentences) of what the app is for and who its users are.

contexts.description: Context catalog: pages, entities, states, relationships, or provenance the app exposes to the agent. May be the empty array; emptiness emits the F_EMPTY_CONTEXTS coverage finding but does not block adoption.

actions.description: Action catalog: machine-readable list of actions with risk class and confirmation gate. May be the empty array; emptiness emits the F_EMPTY_ACTIONS coverage finding but does not block adoption.

inputs.description: Sketch shape for v0 (free-form); a JSON Schema for inputs is a v1 graduation target. Tagged experimental in v0.

effect_class.description: Closed enum per CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.2 and CONCEPT-004 plan section 4.1.3.

gate.description: Closed enum per CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.2. A non-read_only action declaring gate: none emits the F_NON_READONLY_GATE_NONE coverage finding.

cooldown.description: Optional extra gate shape. Tagged experimental in v0 (CONCEPT-001 plan section 3.2).

two_key.description: Optional extra gate shape. Tagged experimental in v0 (CONCEPT-001 plan section 3.2).

binding_status.description: Optional per-action binding tag. Tagged experimental in v0 (CONCEPT-001 plan section 3.2).

rollback.description: Optional free-text rollback or compensation note.

export_targets.description: Optional per-action export-target list (the per-action shape is reserved for future use; v0 contracts typically declare export_targets at the root level).

human_ask.$comment: Shallow-required-conditional. JSON Schema accepts both the empty object {} and the {channel, note} shape. The semantic rule engine emits E_HUMAN_ASK_REQUIRED if {} appears with any non-read_only action (FEATURE-002 plan section 3.3 and CONCEPT-001 plan section 2.1), and E_OUT_OF_BAND_REQUIRED if gate: authorization_required appears on an external/irreversible action with channel != out_of_band (CONCEPT-001 plan section 5.4).

receipts.description: Shallow-required-conditional event-name array the contract guarantees a compliant runtime will emit. The canonical vocabulary is proposed, approved, refused, executed, outcome_recorded (CONCEPT-001 plan section 5.3); contracts MAY add custom receipt event names. Coverage rules R-1..R-4 from CONCEPT-001 plan section 5.3 are enforced by the semantic rule engine.

anti_claims.description: Optional-with-default. If absent from raw input the validator/serializer injects the canonical A0..A14 default below. Explicit [] keeps the array empty and emits the F_EMPTY_ANTI_CLAIMS coverage finding.
default: A0 — AOC is a legibility commitment, not an enforcement commitment.
A1 — AOC does not make an agent act safely. It makes the boundaries an agent operates within legible so a real safety system has something to enforce against.
A2 — There is no readiness score. There are coverage findings per field.
A3 — AOC is not a compliance document. It does not satisfy GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, or similar audit regimes.
A4 - Vendor plugin delivery is a projection target, not a canonical runtime. AOC has no vendor-specific fields.
A5 — AOC is not an internal-system doctrine export. Internal role names and creed text do not appear in this contract.
A6 — No candidate public name appears in package identifiers, marketplace manifests, domains, durable API names, or release artifacts until the public-name gate is locked.
A7 — Publishing an AOC does not declare an app ready as a binary state. Coverage is judged per-field, per-coverage, per-version.
A8 — AOC does not grant any runtime permission to forward a user's bearer token across service boundaries.
A9 — AOC projects into MCP, OpenAPI, A2A, WebMCP, llms.txt, Anthropic Skills, and OpenAI Apps SDK; it does not replace any of them.
A10 — Vendor surfaces are projection targets, not sources of truth. The compatibility registry reports gaps; it does not endorse the vendor.
A11 — Numeric readiness score is forbidden in the schema. Coverage is categorical.
A12 — Receipts are operational artifacts for the agent-app interaction; they are not a substitute for a regulatory audit log.
A13 — llms.txt is a personal and community proposal; the standard cites its status accurately.
A14 — AOC does not promise that WebMCP, agents.json, or OpenAI Apps SDK self-serve flows are stable. The cadenced reverification probe is the load-bearing mitigation.

author.description: Free-form attribution string (org, person, project, or synthetic-app author label).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of contract authoring or generation.

generator.description: Optional generator label. Absence from raw input emits the F_GENERATOR_MISSING coverage finding unconditionally in v0; hand-authored contracts suppress the finding by setting generator: hand-authored (FEATURE-002 plan section 7.5).

user_values.description: Optional builder-stated preferences, tone, or norms the agent should respect. Tagged experimental in v0 (CONCEPT-001 plan section 3.2). Synthetic examples MUST keep values neutral (e.g. 'prefer brevity') and MUST NOT paraphrase doctrine.

hard_boundaries.description: Optional explicit must-not / must-never list. Advisory in v0; tagged experimental.

export_targets.description: Optional array of strings naming wire formats the builder intends to export to (e.g. mcp, openapi, a2a, llms-txt, webmcp, actionspec, skill-md). Builder-asserted intent only; not a canonical pointer. Tagged experimental in v0.

stability.description: Optional sidecar stability map (field name -> stable/experimental/deprecated). The spec text defines default stabilities; this sidecar overrides per contract.
